svg.title: Shared Mobility Data Platform — System Architecture
svg.desc: Live station-status path: GBFS polled every 120 s into the data lake and modelled hourly with dbt; planned next: the poller publishes to Kafka, a Flink SQL job detects short or full stations and an alert consumer stores alerts in PostgreSQL. Batch path: monthly Divvy trip files ingested with Python, cleaned with Spark into Parquet, validated with Great Expectations, loaded into PostgreSQL and modelled with dbt into marts. The lake is an S3 bucket in RustFS on the server (Spark s3a://). Code implemented; first server deployment pending.

text.tspan: poller → dbt now · Kafka → Flink alerts next
all in Docker on the 24 GB server
Parquet · S3 API on the server · s3a:// · private
